terminalContract: For source-envelope Standard routes, publish a trusted immutable declaration without BIN or executable capability. No-input discovery and profile summary distinguish declaration-ready/pending-input from compile success; no accepted session or Build readiness is inferred. Compile only through the existing Profiles compiler with the same captured immutable DP bytes and a published exact-map or profile-declared template route. Application rechecks publication token and exact route before, after adapter execution, and after bind; stale or unsupported captured calls discard results with typed issues and never retry a length-only path. Keep legacy and AB length-only abstract methods; captured overload defaults to fail-closed. FileStamp-only UI selection remains pending unless every accepted stamp, selected slot/path, revision, fingerprint and publication matches a terminal-inspected capability. CLI reads DP once, resolves the exact captured contract, then reads remaining inputs and prepares with the same DP bytes. Preserve legacy routes, CtrlRAM metadata counterpart, output bytes and built-in profiles; B2 owns actual profile/pins/report/warning/Golden promotion.
